rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Snyk API & Web enables AI coding assistants to interact with Snyk's Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) platform through natural language. It supports onboarding scan targets, configuring authentication, running DAST scans, and triaging security findings. Built on FastMCP 2.0, it is the official Snyk MCP server for their API & Web security product.
